facts.title: Kombucha Moscow Mules
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: Fill a highball glass with ice. Pour in 1 part vodka (say, 1.5 ounces) and top it off with 3 parts kombucha (so 4.5 ounces).
Add a generous squeeze of lime and an optional lime wheel for garnish.

notes: Recipe inspired by Love and Lemons.
Change it up: Replace the vodka with pretty much any other basic liquor.
If you love this recipe: You’ll also love my ginger beer concentrate.
facts.summary: Moscow mules made with ginger kombucha instead of ginger beer! If you love kombucha, you’ll love kombucha Moscow mules. Just add vodka and lime.
